name: memory-core
description: MemForge's own memory-system evaluation. 36 deterministic cases across retrieval, duplicate handling, conflict handling, context compilation, the memory lifecycle and agent-memory behaviour. Every case states a corpus, a call and what should have happened; nothing here scores generated prose and no judge model is involved.

cases.title: A relevant profile memory is found by an unrelated corpus
cases.query: which programming languages does the user write
cases.rationale: The single memory that overlaps the query must be returned even though it is a minority of the corpus.
